content.rendered:
Give the gift of glowing skin with the Kiierr Ultimate Glow Gift Bundle. Featuring 4 luxurious skincare essentials, this bundle combines cutting-edge technology with powerful ingredients for a rejuvenating at-home spa experience.

Kiierr Miracle Wand ($149 Value)

Experience EMS, 7 light therapy modes, soothing heat, and relaxing massage to lift, firm, and rejuvenate your skin.

Kiierr Illuminate Mask ($239 Value)

A hands-free LED mask with 7 different light modes to target acne, fine lines, and skin tone for an all-over glow.

Kiierr Radiant Renewal Serum ($49 Value)

Infused with hyaluronic acid to lock in moisture, leaving your skin plump, smooth, and deeply hydrated.

Kiierr Hydrogel Beauty Masks x5 ($49 Value)

Collagen-infused, single-use masks to instantly revive and refresh your complexion.

The Kiierr Ultimate Glow Gift Bundle offers everything you need to achieve beautifully radiant, youthful skin. Treat yourself or give the gift of glowing confidence!
